request.project_task: Build an online symptom triage and appointment routing service.
request.project_goal: Route non-emergency requests while identifying cases needing urgent help.
request.project_description: A patient answers questions; the service gives a routing recommendation and schedules eligible requests.

functional_requirements.text: A patient selects a symptom category.

atoms.text: A patient selects a symptom category.

functional_requirements.text: The system displays an emergency warning when configured red flags are present.

atoms.text: The system displays an emergency warning when configured red flags are present.

functional_requirements.text: The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.

atoms.text: The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.

functional_requirements.text: The patient books an offered appointment.

atoms.text: The patient books an offered appointment.

functional_requirements.text: A clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

atoms.text: A clinician reviews submitted answers before the appointment.

functional_requirements.text: The patient can correct answers before clinician review.

atoms.text: The patient can correct answers before clinician review.

non_functional_requirements.text: The service must state that its output is not a diagnosis.
The requirements do not provide the red-flag rule set.
Sensitive answers must be accessible only to the patient and assigned clinician.

actors.name: Patient
actors.description: A person seeking non-emergency symptom triage and appointment routing.

actors.name: Clinician
actors.description: A healthcare professional who reviews submitted answers before an appointment.

use_cases.name: Complete symptom triage and receive routing recommendation
use_cases.goal: Allow a patient to answer symptom questions and receive a care routing recommendation or emergency warning.
use_cases.trigger: Patient starts a symptom triage session.

preconditions.text: The patient has access to the Triage Route service.

success_postconditions.text: The patient has received a care route recommendation or an emergency warning.

failure_postconditions.text: The triage session is incomplete and no recommendation is provided.

steps.action: The system evaluates answers against configured red flags.
The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.
steps.expected_result: The patient receives a care route recommendation.

alternative_scenarios.name: Patient corrects answers before clinician review

steps.action: Chooses to correct previously submitted answers before clinician review.
steps.expected_result: The system allows the patient to edit answers.
The system updates the recorded answers.

steps.action: The system detects a configured red flag in the patient's answers.
steps.expected_result: The system displays an emergency warning.

user_stories.benefit: I can describe my symptoms and get guidance

user_stories.capability: receive an emergency warning when red flags are present
user_stories.benefit: I know when to seek urgent help

user_stories.capability: receive a care route recommendation for non-emergency answers
user_stories.benefit: I know the appropriate next step for my care

user_stories.capability: correct my answers before clinician review
user_stories.benefit: my information is accurate before it is reviewed

system_stories.system_action: Present category-specific questions after symptom category selection.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure the patient can provide relevant symptom details.

system_stories.system_action: Evaluate answers against configured red flags and display an emergency warning when present.
Recommend a care route for non-emergency answers.
Allow the patient to correct answers before clinician review.

missing_information.description: The red-flag rule set is not provided in the requirements.

unsupported_assumptions.description: Assumed that the system can evaluate answers against configured red flags without the rule set being specified.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Complete symptom triage and receive routing recommendation
Goal: Allow a patient to answer symptom questions and receive a care routing recommendation or emergency warning.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Patient starts a symptom triage session.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The patient has access to the Triage Route service.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Selects a symptom category.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Answers the category-specific questions.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] The system evaluates answers against configured red flags.
  4. [STEP-UC001-004] The system recommends a care route for non-emergency answers.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-ALT-001: Patient corrects answers before clinician review
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Emergency red flag detected
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-007

use_cases.name: Book an offered appointment
use_cases.goal: Allow a patient to book an appointment offered as part of the care route recommendation.
use_cases.trigger: Patient receives an offered appointment after a non-emergency routing recommendation.

preconditions.text: The patient has received a non-emergency care route recommendation with an offered appointment.

success_postconditions.text: The patient has booked an offered appointment.

steps.expected_result: The system confirms the appointment booking.

user_stories.benefit: I can secure a time for my care

system_stories.system_action: Confirm and record the patient's appointment booking.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Book an offered appointment
Goal: Allow a patient to book an appointment offered as part of the care route recommendation.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Patient receives an offered appointment after a non-emergency routing recommendation.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: The patient has received a non-emergency care route recommendation with an offered appointment.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Selects an offered appointment.
Source FRs: FR-005

use_cases.name: Review submitted answers before appointment
use_cases.goal: Allow a clinician to review a patient's submitted answers before the scheduled appointment.
use_cases.trigger: A patient has submitted answers and an appointment is scheduled.

preconditions.text: The patient has submitted answers and an appointment is scheduled.

success_postconditions.text: The clinician has reviewed the submitted answers.

failure_postconditions.text: The clinician cannot access or review the submitted answers.

steps.action: Accesses the patient's submitted answers before the appointment.
steps.expected_result: The system displays the submitted answers to the clinician.

user_stories.capability: review submitted answers before the appointment
user_stories.benefit: I can prepare for the patient's visit

system_stories.system_action: Provide the assigned clinician access to the patient's submitted answers before the appointment.
system_stories.responsibility: Enable clinician review while restricting access to sensitive answers.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Review submitted answers before appointment
Goal: Allow a clinician to review a patient's submitted answers before the scheduled appointment.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: A patient has submitted answers and an appointment is scheduled.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: The patient has submitted answers and an appointment is scheduled.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Accesses the patient's submitted answers before the appointment.
Source FRs: FR-006
